# FDGA031

> DO specify the member slot modifier (`new`, `virtual`, `abstract`, `sealed`, or `override`) immediately after the `static` modifier (if specified).

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section A.1.5 Member Modifiers.

This is a coding style convention. The book treats the appendix A conventions as suggestions, so you can override it.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (full coverage)
- Diagnostics: IDE0036
- Automatic fix: yes
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: verified

## From the book

```csharp
Right: public static new SomeType Create(...)
Wrong: public new static SomeType Create(...)
```
